claim_1.claim: Bulk RNA-seq analysis of whole blood from 18 trial participants on days 0, 1, 3, and 7 after vaccination showed the highest number of differentially expressed genes on day 1, with 10,123 genes significantly differentially expressed compared with day 0.

sources.quote: Differential gene expression from the day 0 baseline was investigated gene-wise using the voom/limma method... The highest number of differentially expressed genes was observed on day 1 after vaccination, with 10,123 genes being significantly differentially expressed compared with day 0.
